GROUND TRANSPORTATION - Taxicab and limousine service available between downtown
scheduled pick-up points and airport, at passenger's expense.
HOTEL RESERVATIONS-Any TWA office will gladly arrange hotel reservations in addition
to airline reservations.
INSURANCE - Trip insurance is available at most airlines offices in the U.S. A.
MEAL SERVICE - For information on Food and Beverage Service, see schedule pages.
RECONFIRMATION - INTERNATIONAL - Passengers holding continuing or return reservations
must reconfirm their reservations at least 72 hours before scheduled flight departure time.
Failure to reconfirm will result in cancellation of all reservations.
RESERVATIONS - Reservations are not definite until tickets are purchased. Passage may
be refused to any person when necessary to comply with Government regulations, tariff
rules, or for reasons beyond the control of TWA.
SCHEDULES - TWA reserves the right to cancel or change schedules without notice. Safety
is our primary consideration. Schedules shown are based on expected flying times. Because
weather and other factors may affect operating conditions, departures and arrivals cannot
be guaranteed.
